title: Arizona Public Service Company 2025 to 2034 Ten-Year Transmission System Plan
summary: Previous plan, superseded by the 2026 plan; useful as the baseline for older WECC cases and for tracking renames and date changes. Totals ~32 mi new 500kV, 578 mi 345kV rebuilds, 149 mi new 230kV, 101 mi 230kV rebuilds, 40 new transformers, 1 STATCOM, $6.24B. Project sheets for 26 projects with old names (TS21, TS22, TS33, Runway Additional), TBD table, RTAP, DG/EE study (2029 case) and planning guidelines.

findings.statement: Totals: ~32 mi new 500kV, 1 mi new 345kV, 578 mi 345kV rebuilds, 149 mi new 230kV OH, 101 mi 230kV rebuilds, 1 mi new 230kV UG, 8 mi 230kV UG upgrades, 1 mi 115kV; 40 new transformers, 3 replacements, 4 shunt reactors, 6 series reactors, 20 shunt capacitors, 1 STATCOM; $6.24B.
Placed in service in 2024: Country Club-Lincoln Street 230kV UG upgrade, Rabbit Canyon Switchyard and Lines, Three Rivers 230kV Line, Serrano Solar and Storage gen-tie.

Dates in this plan that later changed: TS22 2028 (Wafer, 2028 in 2026 plan); Jojoba-Rudd 500kV 2032; TS21 cut-in and TS21-Broadway 2032; Panda-Freedom new line 2030; Pinnacle Peak-Ocotillo 2029; Saguaro Power Campus 2029; Agua Fria-Contrail 2030; Four Corners-Pinnacle Peak 345kV rebuilds 2037.

TBD table also listed Komatke 230/69 substation, Morgan-Outer Circle 230, Delaney-Quartzsite 500/230, Quartzsite-Colorado River 500, TS30 500/230 substation, TS35 substation, Panda-Freedom 230 upgrade; Quartzsite-Colorado River and Komatke were removed in the 2026 plan.

The RTAP says Jojoba-Rudd 500kV and Panda-Freedom 230kV are the current form of the conceptual Palo Verde-Liberty and Gila Bend-Liberty Renewable Transmission Projects (Decision 72057); APS proposes no new RTPs.

DG/EE study (2029 heavy summer): backing out incremental EE/DG adds 771 MW to APS load (598 EE + 173 DG) and 215 MW to SRP (158 EE + 57 DG); no APS overloads; SRP-WAPA ties Duke-Test Track and Rudd-Liberty overloaded under some N-1 contingencies in the base case.
